title: Stroke rehabilitation IPD meta-analysis
goal: A meta-analysis reader can trace IPD-eligible studies and participant totals.

rubric.must: The standard PRISMA four-row layout is visibly present.
The 1,620 identified, 320 removed, and 1,300 screened counts visibly reconcile.
Exclusion boxes visibly account for 1,040 and 214 exclusions.
The final box visibly reports 46 studies, 52 reports, and 12,840 participants.
Connectors clearly trace the selection flow.

ideal.notes: Independently authored using visual-eval/exemplars/prisma/single/ideal.svg (b70f305aa4ed); rendered and visually reviewed. Source retained faithfully but provisional: 260 assessed reports minus 214 excluded leaves 46, while source declares 52 included reports and 46 studies. Retrieval counts are unspecified, labelled as such rather than invented. Resolve source counts before using as a reviewed target.
